tools.name: find_local_pros
tools.description: Use this when someone needs a local, owner-operated home-service business (plumber, HVAC, electrician, roofer, lawn care, tree service or fence) in Oklahoma, Kansas, Nebraska, Iowa or Missouri. Returns up to 5 businesses with name, phone, trade, service area, services and hours so the user can call

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: Use this to check where Local Pros has listings before searching, or when find_local_pros finds nothing: returns every covered city with how many businesses are listed per trade. Coverage is limited to Oklahoma, Kansas, Nebraska, Iowa and Missouri.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to one of the businesses returned by find_local_pros. The business gets an email with the customer's name, contact and problem and replies directly. Ask the user for permission before calling this: it shares their name and contact with the business.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a quote request to one of the businesses returned by find_local_pros. The business gets an email with the customer's name, contact and problem and replies …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
